```{r}
# NEW NMDS CODE -------------------------------------------------------------

# Run NMDS using metaMDS from the 'vegan' package
# Note: 'distance' can be "euclidean" to match your UMAP, or "bray" for typical ecology profiles.
# 'autotransform = FALSE' because you already normalized range using caret.
photo_nmdsresult <- metaMDS(photo_proc, 
                            distance = "euclidean", 
                            k = 2, 
                            trymax = 100, 
                            autotransform = TRUE)

# Print the stress to your console to check fit quality
print(paste("NMDS Stress:", photo_nmdsresult$stress))

# Option 1: Quick Base R Plot (similar to your old script)
plot(photo_nmdsresult$points[,1], photo_nmdsresult$points[,2], 
     pch=19, cex=0.9, las=1,
     xlab="NMDS1", ylab="NMDS2", 
     main=paste("Photophys NMDS\nStress:", round(photo_nmdsresult$stress, 4)))

# Option 2: Clean ggplot version (Highly recommended for your metadata mapping later)
nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(photo_nmdsresult, display = "sites"))
nmds_scores$SampleID <- rownames(nmds_scores)

# Quick look at the coordinate space
ggplot(nmds_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Photophys NMDS", 
       subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(photo_nmdsresult$stress, 4)))
```
```{r}
# NEW NMDS PLOTTING CODE (with Color by Site and Shape by Species) ----------------------
# Trajectory NMDSs 
## Photophys NMDS   

######### set up photophys dataframe ######## 
longphoto <- as.data.frame(t(photophys))
colnames(longphoto) <- longphoto[1,] 
longphoto <- as.data.frame(longphoto[-1:-5,]) # removing metrix, stage, col 
longphoto[,2:955] <- lapply(longphoto[,2:955], as.numeric)
longphoto$SampleID <- rownames(longphoto)
longphoto <- longphoto %>% relocate(SampleID)
fullyears <- longphoto 
fullyears <- data.frame(fullyears[, colSums(is.na(fullyears)) == 0])

allphoto <- fullyears %>% dplyr::select(-contains('Fo'), -contains('Fm'))
rownames(allphoto) <- allphoto$SampleID
photophys_clean <- allphoto %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(SampleID)) # remove non-numeric columns 
photophys_clean <- photophys_clean %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
allphoto[,2:ncol(allphoto)] <- allphoto[,2:ncol(allphoto)] %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

photo.transit <- preProcess(x = photophys_clean, rangeBounds = c(0, 1), method = "range") # need to scale data 
photo_proc <- predict(photo.transit, photophys_clean)
photo_proc <- photo_proc[,-nearZeroVar(photo_proc)] # remove any columns with low variance across samples 
photo_proc <- photo_proc %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ sum(is.na(.)) == 0))

# --- NEW NMDS COMPONENT ---
# Using Euclidean distance to match your prior UMAP setup
photo_nmdsresult <- metaMDS(photo_proc, distance = "euclidean", k = 2, trymax = 100, autotransform = FALSE)


##### linking metadata to nmds points ###### 
nmds_plotting_data <- data.frame(
  NMDS1    = photo_nmdsresult$points[,1], 
  NMDS2    = photo_nmdsresult$points[,2], 
  SampleID = allphoto$SampleID
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Isolate Fiji vs Tutuila upfront for cleaner logic
    is_fiji = str_detect(SampleID, "lpv|bpv|bad|nah"),
    
    # Identify Species cleanly
    Species = case_when(
      str_detect(SampleID, "nah")  ~ "AD_C",
      str_detect(SampleID, "bad")  ~ "AH_C",
      str_detect(SampleID, "lad")  ~ "AH_C",
      str_detect(SampleID, "lpv") ~ "PVER_D",
      str_detect(SampleID, "bpv") ~ "PVER_D",
      TRUE                           ~ str_to_upper(substr(str_extract(SampleID, "(?<=_).+?(?=\\.)"), 1, 4))
    ),
    
    # Create a clean plotting label: Use numeric Site for Tut, or "FJ" / Species short-code for Fiji
    PlotLabel = case_when(
      is_fiji ~ "F", 
      TRUE    ~ str_extract(SampleID, "(?<=t)\\d+(?=_)")
    ),
    
    # Build Genotype string without triggering formatC coercion warnings
    Genotype = case_when(
      is_fiji ~ paste0(Species, "_", str_extract(SampleID, "[^.]+")),
      TRUE    ~ {
        # This block only executes calculations safely for your original Tut samples
        tut_colony <- str_extract(SampleID, "(?<=_).+?(?=\\.)")
        tut_site   <- as.numeric(str_extract(SampleID, "(?<=t)\\d+(?=_)"))
        tut_num    <- as.numeric(str_extract(tut_colony, "\\d+$")) # Extracts trailing numbers safely
        
        paste0(Species,
               "_s", formatC(tut_site, flag = "0", width = 2),
               "_c", formatC(tut_num, flag = "0", width = 2))
      }
    )
  )

ggplot(nmds_plotting_data, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
  # Use PlotLabel so Fiji ("FJ") and Tutuila (Sites) both render
  geom_text(aes(label = PlotLabel, color = Species),
            size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Customizing scales if you want clear separation of colors
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") + 
  
  labs(title = "Photophysiology NMDS",
       subtitle = paste("Fiji (F) and Tutuila (Site #) Samples | Stress:", round(photo_nmdsresult$stress, 4)),
       x = "NMDS Dimension 1",
       y = "NMDS Dimension 2",
       color = "Species") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
```{r}
library(vegan)

# 1. Isolate factors and treat 'PlotLabel' explicitly as your Site_Run block
meta_factors <- nmds_plotting_data %>% 
  dplyr::select(Species, PlotLabel) # PlotLabel is your Site/Run variable

# 2. Run PERMANOVA restricting permutations WITHIN your Site_Run blocks
# This safely tests the Species effect while accounting for the confounded Run/Site effect
permanova_species <- adonis2(photo_proc ~ Species, 
                             data = meta_factors, 
                             method = "euclidean", 
                             strata = meta_factors$PlotLabel, # Restricts permutations within Site/Run
                             permutations = 999)

print(permanova_species) #R2 is 0.299! 

# Calculate the Euclidean distance matrix first
photo_dist <- vegdist(photo_proc, method = "euclidean")

# Run betadisper using that distance matrix and the Species column from meta_factors
disper <- betadisper(photo_dist, meta_factors$Species)
permutest(disper)

boxplot(disper, 
        xlab = "Species", 
        ylab = "Distance to Centroid", 
        main = "Multivariate Dispersion (Variance) Across Species")

# If you don't have it installed: 
 devtools::install_github("pmartinezarbizu/pairwiseAdonis/pairwiseAdonis")
library(pairwiseAdonis)

pairwise_results <- pairwise.adonis2(photo_proc ~ Species, 
                                     data = meta_factors, 
                                     method = "euclidean", 
                                     strata = "PlotLabel", # Note: string format here
                                     nperm = 999)

# Print the pairwise comparisons
print(pairwise_results)
```
